Commentary.Commentary: That's it then from this game and this series as well. Aaron Finch has been handed the trophy and the Australia players are posing for some team pictures. Australia will now host England in a three-game T20I series leading up to the T20 World Cup. The first match will be played on 9th October at 1.40 pm IST (8.10 am GMT). On the other hand, West Indies will take on UAE in the ICC Men's T20 World Cup warm-up match on 10th October at 5.30 am IST (12 am GMT). Do join us for the coverage. Till then, take care and goodbye.

The skipper of Australia, Aaron Finch says that it was an incredible win and the difference were David Warner and Tim David. He credits David for his batting performance. Adds that one is always learning and that there will be challenges. Mentions that they are trying to manage the workload of the players for the England series to keep them fresh for the World Cup.

Nicholas Pooran, captain of West Indies says that the Aussies were the better team and deserved to win and congratulates them. Adds that they are getting accustomed to the conditions and hopes to do well in the upcoming World Cup.

David Warner (75 off 42 balls) is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH and the SERIES as well. Warner says that it was a fantastic all round performance. He praises their bowlers for the way they defended this total. Adds that he had a nice little break and is looking forward to Perth. Mentions that Cameron Green is like himself when he first started and further adds that he will have a big impact in the future.

Earlier in the game, Nicholas Pooran won the toss and elected to field and after picking up an early wicket, David Warner counter-attacked. This put the Windies' bowlers under pressure and runs started to flow. The visitors did manage to get rid of Warner and pulled things back a bit. Then came a powerful cameo by Tim David but once again the Windies bowlers came back and ended on a high. Alzarri Joseph was very impressive and so were a couple of other bowlers. Chasing 179 runs to win at the Gabba was never going to be easy and the failure of the middle-order made things very difficult for the visitors. In the end, they lost the game by a fair bit.

West Indies were behind the eight ball right from the off with Kyle Mayers departing early. Brandon King looked pretty good though and Johnson Charles managed to stay at the crease. Once King fell though, the middle order just couldn't get any momentum in the chase. Rovman Powell and Akeal Hosein did manage to hit a few lusty blows and Hosein in particular looked good but it was already a bit too late by then. The Windies will now look to reflect on the little things they did wrong and gear up for the upcoming T20 World Cup.

Australia had a big total on the board and needed a couple of quick wickets. Mitchell Starc got rid of Kyle Mayers in the very first over but they couldn't get another breakthrough in the Powerplay. It was then Adam Zampa who broke a dangerous partnership between King and Charles. The Aussies were then able to pick up frequent wickets in the middle phase and had the game well in control. Their bowlers managed to fend off a late charge from Powell and Hosein and got over the line with ease with Starc picking up four wickets.

A comfortable victory in the end for Australia and they have sealed the two-game T20I series 2-0. West Indies were competitive in both games but just didn't have enough firepower with bat or ball to get past the Aussies.
A dot to end then! Mitchell Starc bowls a back of the hand slower one, short and outside off, Alzarri Joseph looks to hit it but misses. AUSTRALIA WIN BY 31 RUNS AND TAKES THE SERIES 2-0.
This is full and on middle, Yannic Cariah drills it towards mid on for a run.
Mitchell Starc goes for the yorker again but bowls a low full toss, on middle, Alzarri Joseph tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Another yorker, on off, Alzarri Joseph digs it back to the bowler.
WIDE! A yorker but down the leg side, Alzarri Joseph misses his flick. Wided.
On a length and around off, Yannic Cariah guides it towards point for a single.
Yannic Cariah is the next batter in.

OUT! TIMBER! Mitchell Starc gets his fourth wicket and this is a peach of a delivery. He nails the yorker from over the wicket, on middle, Odean Smith moves across but cannot put his bat down in time to block it. The ball goes through and rattle the stumps. West Indies 8 down now and Mitchell Starc has 5 balls to take a five-wicket haul.
Mitchell Starc will bowl the final over. Australia are an over behind and will have to bring in an extra fielder for the final over and Aaron Finch doesn't seem happy about it.
A slower one, full and on off, Alzarri Joseph swings wildly but only connects with thin air.
FOUR! Too little too late for West Indies! This is full and on off, Alzarri Joseph swings and gets an outside edge past the short third man fielder for a boundary.
Full and on off, Alzarri Joseph slices it wide of sweeper cover for a brace.
FOUR! Alzarri Joseph gets off the mark in style! This is on a good length and on leg, Akeal Hosein moves across and flicks it over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Alzarri Joseph is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! A good little cameo from Akeal Hosein comes to an end. Pat Cummins serves this full and around off, Akeal Hosein looks to smash it over mid off but his bat turns as soon as he connects and the ball goes flat and straight into the hands of David Warner who makes no mistake.
Commentary.Howout: c David Warner b Pat Cummins

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Nice shot! This is short and on middle, Akeal Hosein stays there and pulls it towards the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Sharp bouncer! Josh Hazlewood bangs in a pacy bouncer, on middle, Odean Smith ducks under it and Matthew Wade does well to take it behind the stumps.
A full toss, on leg, Akeal Hosein drills it towards long on for a run.
This is on a good length and outside off, slower too, Akeal Hosein looks to cut it away but misses. He is not happy with himself.
On a length and on off, Odean Smith forces it towards extra cover for a single.
This is almost in the blockhole, Odean Smith looks for the big shot but gets an inside edge onto his boots as the ball dies on the pitch.
Short of a length and on off, Odean Smith forces it towards long off for a single. The fielder there throws it towards the bowler who fumbles and the batters gets an overthrow.
Josh Hazlewood (3-0-15-0) is back on to finish his spell.
Short of a length and around off, slower again, Akeal Hosein makes room to go downtown but miscues it in the air, Steven Smith from mid on puts it dive but cannot reach it. Two runs taken.
Another slower one, short and on leg, Odean Smith works it through square leg for a single and gets off the mark.
Odean Smith walks out to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! Pat Cummins gets his man this time and this might be the game for Australia. He bowls this short of a length and on off, slower too, Rovman Powell goes for the pull shot but is early into it and miscues it high in the air towards the leg slip region. Matthew Wade calls for it, settles under it and completes a nice catch. West Indies are six down now.
Commentary.Howout: c Matthew Wade b Pat Cummins

Commentary.Commentary: Pat Cummins nails the yorker, outside off, Rovman Powell throws his bat at it but misses.
On a length and on middle, Akeal Hosein tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.

Oh..that was close! A lucky escape for Powell. Pat Cummins bowls this on a good length and on middle, Rovman Powell looks to pull it away but gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball rolls towards the stumps and hits it but the bails remain intact. A single is taken.
WIDE! Pat Cummins serves this on a yorker length and outside off, Rovman Powell tries to reach for it but misses. It is called a wide.
Pat Cummins (2-0-12-0) is back into the attack.
A googly now, short and on off, turning away, Akeal Hosein swings at it but cannot connect.
Floated, full and on middle, Akeal Hosein goes for the slog again but misses and gets hit high on the pads.
SIX! BANG! This is tossed up, full and on middle, in the slot, Akeal Hosein stays there and heaves it over the wide long on fence for a biggie. This is turning out to be a huge over for the Windies.

FOUR BYES!  Adam Zampa sees the batter move across and darts this one full and down the leg, Akeal Hosein misses his heave but Matthew Wade cannot stop it as well as the ball races towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
EDGED AND FOUR! This is floated, full and outside off, Akeal Hosein moves across to play the slog-sweep but gets an outside edge towards the vacant third man fence for a boundary.
Short and on off, Rovman Powell moves back and slaps it towards long off for a single.
Adam Zampa (3-0-23-1) is back on.
Hazlewood gets it in the blockhole outside off and Powell can only manage to squeeze it towards deep cover for a single. 75 needed now off 30 balls.
Full and outside off, Powell let's it through to the keeper.
banged in short and outside off, Rovman Powell swats kit away off the higher part of the bat and in front of square on the off side for a couple of runs.
Around the hips, this is tucked away off the back foot towards square leg for a run.
Pace and bounce for Hazlewood! Good length, following the batter down the leg side. Hosein swings wildly at it but is well beaten.
FOUR! Top shot! Back of a length and around off, Akeal Hosein backs away and hammers it over covers to find the fence.
Josh Hazlewood comes back into the attack now. He has conceded only 7 runs in his two overs.
Green keeps it short and outside off, Hosein looks to take it on yet again and this time he gets a top edge that flies down to third man. Just the single then.

Slight halt! Akeal Hosein has been hit on the helmet. A mandatory concussion check is ongoing. Rovman Powell is also taking this time to do a bit of stretching with the help of the physio. Everything looks good now and we are ready to continue.

Off the glove and onto the helmet! No, hits the shoulder. This is served on a good length, around off and Akeal Hosein looks to take it on. Hosein takes his eyes off the ball and takes a blow straight onto the left shoulder. That is a sore one for the batter.
Shorter and slower, close to the off pole. Powell stays back and edges it down with soft hands towards third man for one more.
Back of a length and around off, Hosein hops and guides it down to third man for a single.
BEATEN! Green comes from 'round the wicket and serves a good-length ball in that channel around off. Akeal Hosein looks to play at it but is beaten past the outside edge.
Slower delivery, full and outside off, hit away off the toe end of the bat towards mid off for a quick single.
Cameron Green (3-0-31-1) to finish his spell now.
Good length, on middle and leg, Akeal Hosein gets behind the line to make the block.
Akeal Hosein is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! High on the bat and straight down the throat of the fielder. Mitchell Starc bowls this one shorter and over off stump. Jason Holder looks to hang deep and pull it over the mid-wicket fence but gets it off the toe end of the bat. The ball goes towards the man at deep mid-wicket and Cameron Green takes a simple catch. Australia have their fifth and Starc has his third. West Indies now need 87 runs off 43 deliveries.
Commentary.Howout: c Cameron Green b Mitchell Starc

Commentary.Commentary: Great hustle by David Warner and he saves three runs for his side. Short of a length and around off, Powell muscles it towards wide long on for just a single.
A bit of an extra bounce there for Starc. Good length, on off, Powell looks to block but is surprised by the bounce and gets hit on the gloves.
Very full and wide, Rovman Powell reaches out and slices it behind point for a couple of runs.
Good shot for just a single. Good length, angling across the right-hander. Holder stands tall and taps it towards sweeper cover for a run.
Mitchell Starc (2-0-12-2) comes back into the attack.
RIPPER! Adam Zampa bowls this quicker, short and on off, turning away slighlty, Rovman Powell looks to play at it but gets beaten on the outside edge. This is good contest between bat and ball.
SIX! What a shot! Adam Zampa tosses it up, full and on off, Rovman Powell goes down and slog-sweeps it over the wide long on fence for a biggie. A good reply to the previous delivery.

The wrong 'un almost does the trick for Adam Zampa but Powell survives. This is served on a length and around off, spinning in. Powell looks to block it out but misses and gets pinged on the pads. There is a huge appeal for LBW and the finger goes up! Rovman Powell does review it in an instant and the third umpire is called into action. There is nothing on Hotspot and UltraEdge shows that there is no bat involved. Ball Tracking shows that the ball is just going over the leg stump and the on-field decision is reversed.
Around off, this is stroked away uppishly towards wide mid off for a single.
FOUR! Dead straight! Tossed up outside off, Jason Holder reaches out and chips it down the ground. Steven Smith from long on tries to get around but can't reach it and it will be a boundary.
Quicker one, fuller and around off. Powell eases it through cover for a single.

Slower delivery, on a good length and around off. Holder works it off the back foot and into the vacant mid-wicket region. The batters look for two as the bowler chases it down and they get it with ease in the end.
Fullish length, around off, Holder plays it off the back foot and down to short third man.
Length ball, outside off. Rovman Powell guides it down to third man for a run.
Rovman Powell comes out to the middle now.

OUT! TAKEN! Matthew Wade takes a brilliant catch and finally, Johnson Charles has been put out of his misery. Another off-paced delivery by Cameron Green, on a good length and around middle. Charles clears the front leg and looks for the big shot down the ground but edns up miscuing it badly. The ball goes a long way up and around the leg slip region. The keeper, Wade settles under it and takes it well. West Indies lose their 4th wicket now.
Commentary.Howout: c Matthew Wade b Cameron Green

Commentary.Commentary: This is the off-cutter by Green, on a length and outside off. Jason Holder cuts it down to third man and rotates the strike.
Back of a length and over middle, this is pulled away in front of mid-wicket for a couple of runs by Holder.
Cameron Green (2-0-25-0) is back on.
Floated, full and on middle, Jason Holder tucks it through mid-wicket for one more. Six singles in the over!
Shorter in length and on middle, Johnson Charles moves back and forces it towards long on for one.
Tossed up, full and on off, Jason Holder chips it down to long off for another run.
A bit short and around off, Johnson Charles cuts it towards backward point for a run.
Slower through the air, on middle, Jason Holder works it of the inner half towards short fine leg for a quick single.
Zampa drags this one down around middle, Charles waits for it and knocks it down to long on for a single.
Good length, angling across the right-hander. Holder hangs back and slashes it away behind point for a couple of runs.
A quick bumper now, over leg stump, Jason Holder just ducks under it.

OUT! TAKEN! A good catch by the skipper, Aaron Finch and credit goes to his captaincy as well to put himself in that position. Mitchell Starc bowls this short and around off, Nicholas Pooran goes for the pull shot but hits it hard and straight into the hands of Aaron Finch who is stationed at short mid-wicket. A really good catch falling backwards as it was hit very hard at him. Nicholas Pooran has to go back now and Mitchell Starc gets his second wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Aaron Finch b Mitchell Starc

Commentary.Commentary: Jason Holder is the new man in.
WIDE! Mitchell Starc serves this full and down the leg, Nicholas Pooran misses his flick. Wided.
Mitchell Starc bowls this short and on middle, Johnson Charles pulls it towards deep square leg for a run.
Short of a length and around off, Nicholas Pooran guides it towards point for a single.

This is on a length and on off, Johnson Charles strokes it towards mid off, Nicholas Pooran sets off for the run and Charles responds a bit late. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses as Charles puts a dive in. The batters complete the run.
Mitchell Starc (1-0-6-1) is back on.
Flatter one around off, this is punched away off the back foot towards cover-point. The fielder makes a good stop but the throw fired in is a bit wide and that allows a single.
Tossed up, around off, Pooran leans in and drives it down to long off for a single.
Windies skipper, Nicholas Pooran walks in at number 4.

OUT! STUMPED! Adam Zampa strikes in his first over and sends King back to the hut. Zampa bowls the googly, on middle and pulls his length back a bit seeing the batter giving the charge. Brandon King skips down the track to heave it away but misses the ball completely and Matthew Wade behind the stumps does well to collect it and take the bails off. West Indies lose their second wicket now.
Commentary.Howout: st Matthew Wade b Adam Zampa

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, full and on off, Johnson Charles drives it towards long off for a single.
Quicker one, full and on off, skidding through, Johnson Charles looks to drive it away but misses and it goes just past the stumps.
Adam Zampa starts with a googly, short and on middle, turning in, Johnson Charles moves back and punches it through covers for a brace.
Spin for the first time in this innings as Adam Zampa has been brought into the attack.
Pat Cummins bowls this on a hard length and on off again, Brandon King taps it towards point.
Another length delivery on off, slower too, Johnson Charles waits for it and guides it towards third man for a single.
This is back of a length and on off, Johnson Charles gets a leading edge towards point.

SIX! BANG! Johnson Charles finally connects one and sends it way over the stands. Pat Cummins bowls this a touch fuller and on middle, Johnson Charles stays there and heaves it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
On a length and around middle, Brandon King moves across and tries to play the slog-sweep but misses and the ball goes off the pads in front of the keeper on the leg side. A leg bye is taken.
This is on a hard length and outside off, Brandon King looks to push it away but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Another slower one, on a length and on leg, Johnson Charles looks to heave it away but misses. West Indies are on 45 for 1 after the end of Powerplay.

Oh..that was close! This is the off-cutter, on a length and on leg, Brandon King looks to play at it but misses as the ball just goes past the leg stump. The keeper spills it and the batters get a bye run.
FOUR! Class shot! Cameron Green pitches it up, on middle, Brandon King stays there and smashes it over the bowler's head for a boundary now. 15 runs already in 4 balls.
WIDE! Green bangs in a bouncer, on middle, Brandon King misses his pull shot. It is called a wide for height.
Short and outside off, Brandon King looks to cut it away but misses.
SIX! Great shot! This is the slower one, full and on leg, Brandon King makes room and lofts it over mid on for a biggie.
FOUR! Picked his spot! Cameron Green bowls this short of a length and on off, Brandon King moves across and swivel pulls it towards deep backward square leg fence for a boundary.
Brilliant bowling from Hazlewood and he closes the over with a fourth dot ball on the trot. Another bumper, over middle. Charles looks to play at it but takes his eyes off the ball and misses.
Length ball, around off, this is hit away off the toe end of the bat towards mid on.

Swing and a miss! Perfect length from Josh Hazlewood, this one angles in a long way from around off. Johnson Charles has a wild swipe across the line but is beaten all ends up and the ball goes just over the stumps.
Hazlewood serves a bumper now, over off stump and with good pace behind it as well. Charles swings and misses.
On a hard length and over middle, King mistimes the pull shot down to mid on for a single.
FOUR! Beautifully timed by Brandon King. Just a tad bit short and on leg stump. King stays back and just eases it well in front of mid-wicket for a boundary.
Josh Hazlewood is back on. He conceded just 2 runs in his first over.
Fuller now, on middle and this is punched straight towards mid on.
FOUR! And again! A lot finer this time though. Another short ball, over middle and leg, Charles tries to pull but gets a top edge that flies over the keeper's head and into the fence.
FOUR! This is short and at the body, Charles pulls it awkwardly but manages to get it wide of the man at backward square leg. The ball runs away into the fence.
Nicely bowled! Good length, in that channel close to the off stump. Johnson Charles looks to cut it fine but misses.
Short of a length, on middle and leg and this is just swung away to the left of the fielder at deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Johnson Charles doesn't seem comfortable out there. This is full and angled onto the pads by Green. Charles looks to whip it away but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Cameron Green comes into the attack now.
Cummins bangs this one in over middle stump and Brandon King pulls it in front of mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Length ball, on off, King blocks it out.

DROPPED! Adam Zampa drops a regulation catch and Johnson Charles gets a reprieve. This is pitched up by Pat Cummins on off stump. Charles clears the front leg and just skies it off the toe end towards long off. Zampa settles under it nicely but the ball just pops in and out of his hands. A single is taken and that could turn out to be a costly miss.
Fraction shorter and well outside off, Charles just cuts it uppishly and towards deep backward point for a couple of runs.
Good length, angling in from around off, Charles gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Cummins starts off with a length ball outside off. Johnson Charles just doesn't move his feet and swings wildly across the line. Charles misses the ball by a mile.
Pat Cummins replaces Mitchell Starc.
Perfect length from Hazlewood, around middle and leg. King goes on the back foot and just about manages to keep it out on the leg side.
King is off the mark now! Fullish length, angling into leg stump, King flicks it away past square leg and races back for the second.
Good length, around off and shaping away yet again. King plays it late and with the swing towards cover.
A bit of movement on offer that time around. Nagging length, outside off and the ball shapes away nicely. Brandon King has a little dab at it but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Leg bye! Length again, angling down leg, Charles looks to tuck it away but misses. The ball goes off the hips and towards square leg as the batters get a leg bye.
Josh Hazlewood starts off with a length ball, top of the off line and Johnson Charles just blocks it out.
Josh Hazlewood to share the attack with Mitchell Starc.
Full and around off, nicely driven but straight towards mid off. Just the six and a wicket off the first over, a good one for Australia.
Brandon King walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Oh, my God! Mitchell Starc has taken an absolute blinder of a return catch and Kyle Mayers cannot believe it. Starc serves a low full toss, angling in from around off and at over 141 clicks. Mayers punches it firmly back towards the bowler. The ball goes to just the right of Starc who sticks out his left hand on the followthrough and manages to somehow grasp it. A bit of magic has provided Australia an early breakthrough here.
SIX! A bit of calypso magic in that one. Pitched up on off stump, Kyle Mayers just stands tall and thumps it right back over the bowler's head. The ball flies over the ropes for a maximum.
Around 140 clicks again and on a length, angling onto the pads. Mayers looks to tuck it away but fails to do so.
Good length, over middle and touching 140 clicks. Mayers stays back and edges it down towards the gully region.
Mitchell Starc runs in and starts off with a short ball over leg stump. This one is going on with the angle and Kyle Mayers just ducks under it.
